title: Valora Insights - Implementation Sprint Notes (Field Notebook)
content:
Context:
Quick capture from kickoff + sprint planning with Valora Insights (3/10 sync). Customer is a mid-market analytics vendor; requires Private (VPC) deployment with KMS-managed keys and strict egress controls. Primary goal: ingest customer queries from Valora platform, serve semantic search + conversational assistant with latency SLOs for interactive UIs.

High-level requirements (as stated):
- Private deployment (VPC peering) in us-west-2.
- Data must not egress to public internet; allow only HTTPS to our control plane and KMS endpoints.
- P95 response (generation) target: <= 250ms for short prompts (<=512 tokens); P95 for embeddings <= 80ms.
- Throughput target: sustained 120 QPS embeddings during business hours; burst to 400 QPS for 10m windows.
- Model: open-architecture LLM recommended (quantized 8-bit) with reranker hybrid flow. Want to test both 13B + 30B variants.
- Audit logs retained 90 days and exported to Valora S3 (they will provide export bucket and role).

Technical notes / gotchas observed on call:
- Valora infra team uses aggressive egress firewall (stateful L4) that drops ephemeral ranges; need to provide specific IP ranges and ports for control-plane callbacks and health probes. Action: provide static egress IPs for callbacks (Liam).
- Their KMS requires cross-account grants with external ID. KMS rotation policy: monthly. Need to validate our Private control plane supports external-id grants and automated key rotation testing.
- Dataset access pattern: they plan to precompute embeddings and store in their vector DB but want us to run on-the-fly reranking for freshness. This implies mixed workload of batch embedding ingest + low-latency rerank. Batching strategy must not increase tail latency.
- The customer has a legacy L7 L4LB (HAProxy) that terminates TLS and expects sticky sessions; we should confirm whether session affinity breaks our routing for canary switchover.
- On-prem connectivity option (future): they may want an air-gapped appliance for EU customers. Note: licensing + offline model packaging will be separate contract.

Sizing / infra assumptions (initial estimate):
- For 120 sustained embeddings QPS: 4x A10G (or 2x A100-40GB) worker nodes with async batching + caching for embedding ingest pipelines.
- For chat/generation 13B @ 250ms P95: 2x H100 or 4x A100s (depends on quantization path). If quantize to 8-bit / trimmed KV cache this may drop to 2x A100.
- Storage: 2TB NVMe per worker (for model shards + KV cache).
- Network: VPC peering with route tables + NAT config for control-plane egress; minimum MTU 9000 recommended for larger payloads.
- Ballpark monthly infra e2e estimate (hosted equivalent): $9k–$15k depending on GPU mix. NOTE: conservative until we run perf tests.

Operational / rollout plan suggestions:
1) Stage 0 (lab): spin up a private cluster in our staging VPC; run their sample traffic (provided as JSON traces). Goal: reproduce 95th latency and QPS profile. (owner: Owen, due: 2026-03-17)
2) Stage 1 (VPC peering): provision peering with Valora dev account; handshake + routing validation, KMS grant test. (owner: Priya, due: 2026-03-19)
3) Stage 2 (canary): route 2% traffic for 48h; monitor cost, latency, and quality metrics. Canary fallback route to hosted variant. (owner: Maya, due: 2026-03-25)
4) Stage 3 (rollout): progressive rollout to 25% then 100% over 7 days with immediate rollback thresholds (P95 > 350ms or error rate > 0.8%).

Open questions (to clarify with Valora):
- Exact token distribution of typical user queries (avg token length). They mentioned many short queries but need sample histogram.
- Are they using a managed vector DB (Pinecone/Weaviate) or self-hosted? We need the latency budget for reranker roundtrip.
- Does their security team require a private CA for mTLS between their app and our nodes? If yes, certificate onboarding steps.
- Confirm whether audit exports to customer S3 must be server-side encrypted with their KMS key (yes/no).

Action items (quick):
- Liam: compile list of control-plane IPs + port ranges (due 3/11).
- Priya: run KMS external-id grant test with staging Valora account and document steps + caveats (due 3/13).
- Owen: generate perf test harness and replay tool for Valora trace (due 3/17).
- Maya: draft runbook for canary rollback thresholds + alerting rules; include PagerDuty escalation (due 3/20).
- All: sync next on 3/15; prepare checklist for access (VPC CIDRs, VPC peering role, S3 role, KMS key ARN).

Notes to self / heuristics:
- If they push large batch jobs during business hours, consider autoscale window that caps scale-up to keep latency stable; prefer burst capacity instead of aggressive autoscale.
- Watch for tokenization differences between their preprocessing and our token counters (can artificially inflate costs). Add a small tool to compare token counts sample-wise.
- Log volume could be heavy due to debug-level tracing early; propose 7-day high retention then standard 90-day reduced retention to avoid egress cost shock.

Meeting crumbs / quotes: 
- "We can't allow any data to leave our VPC without explicit ACLs" (Valora security lead) — watch for accidental S3 presigned URLs.
- They like our autoscale/burst model, but want clear cost cap guardrails (billing alerts + token budgets).

Reference artifacts to attach later: perf-logs from staging run, sample traffic JSON, KMS grant snippet, VPC route table screenshot.

End of capture. Will tidy and drop into Confluence once Stage 0 perf runs done.
